label: good existing-pattern coverage; cross-problem target
task: Let (X,d) be a nonempty totally bounded metric space, Y a normed real vector space, and F a nonempty family of maps X→Y. Assume uniform equicontinuity: for each ε>0 one δ>0 works for every f in F and every x,y in X. Assume pointwise boundedness: for each x there exists finite B_x≥0 with ||f(x)||≤B_x for every f in F. Prove one finite M bounds ||f(x)|| for all f and x. Explain whether merely requiring each f to be uniformly continuous suffices.
